major_cooldowns.name: Bestial Wrath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown with your potion, racial and stat trinket already up and your pet already attacking your target, or you lose the Bloodshed bleed.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast and self aura share id 19574 (CAST 5/5 parses, SELF AURA 5/5). Cooldown is the table's base_cd_s of 90; no source states the talented value, and the sampled parses press it far more often than once per 90s, so the lost-cast check is deliberately lenient.

major_cooldowns.name: Empowering Venom
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it just before Bestial Wrath so the secondary stat buff is live when the opening hit lands.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use stat trinket, id 1293316, CAST in 3/5 parses. The guide only gives timing for stat trinkets as a class; talent_gated is set so players carrying a different trinket are not flagged for zero casts.

defensives.name: Survival of the Fittest
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into a known raid hit to cut 30% off the damage you and your pet take.

defensives.name: Exhilaration
defensives.usage_rule: Use it after a big hit to heal yourself for 30% and put your pet back to full.

defensives.name: Aspect of the Turtle
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for a lethal mechanic, since it makes attacks miss you but locks you out of attacking.

rules.description: Open Barbed Shot into Bestial Wrath then Kill Command
rules.action: Dump both Barbed Shot charges off the pull, then Bestial Wrath once your pet is on the target, then Kill Command.

rules.description: Barbed Shot charge spent before Bestial Wrath
rules.action: Spend a Barbed Shot charge as Bestial Wrath comes up so it is not sitting capped through the window.

rules.description: Bank Kill Command charges for Bestial Wrath
rules.action: Stop pressing Kill Command as Bestial Wrath comes off cooldown so you enter the window with both charges.

rules.description: Cobra Shot over Barbed Shot while Cobra Fang is up
rules.action: Press Cobra Shot ahead of Barbed Shot whenever Cobra Fang is stacked on you.

rules.description: Wild Thrash added to the priority on AoE
rules.action: Add Wild Thrash to the priority as enemies stack up, and use it to put Beast Cleave up before Bestial Wrath.
